mostWorthwhile.text: Following the tail cloud into the outward stream was most worthwhile: the encounter showed how the cloud could lose material while its main body continued.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial tail-gas combination was less engaging because it established a location and history without yet showing the cloud's fate.

surprise.text: I expected the flows to merge, so the stream stripping the tail cloud's edge surprised me.

arbitrary.text: The final two combinations were clear enough in purpose, but following the only offered action left little meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would continue: the different fates of the stripped gas and surviving clumps made me curious about what the new knot might become.
